{{Top|leg}}
'''Cags''' were predatory marsupials native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baros]]. Their presence caused the [[Brubb]]s to develop a dense hide and the ability to change their [[Color/Legends|color]] to blend in with the surrounding environment.
